store_data.about_the_game:
Rummy Odyssey: The Roguelite Revolution of Classic Rummy

Rummy Odyssey blends Rummy mechanics with modern Roguelite strategy and the excitement of Deckbuilding.

Defeat the luck factor with your strategy, manipulate your deck, and combine powerful Jokers to multiply your points.

This is not just a game where you arrange tiles and finish; it is a strategic journey where you try to form the best combinations to reach the target score in every round.

                         

                                   

🟢 THE GAME MECHANIC IS VERY SIMPLE

No complex rules. Your goal is to group the tiles in your hand and lay them on the table according to three simple rules:

1. Same Numbers: Tiles with the same number but different colors (e.g., Red 7, Blue 7, Black 7).

2. Sequential Numbers: Consecutive numbers in the same color (e.g., Blue 4, 5, 6).

3. Same Color and Number: Keep identical tiles of the same color and number together (e.g., Red 4, Red 4).

Match tiles, collect points, and advance to the next round. But beware: the target score you need to reach increases with every round!

                   

🔥 BREAK THE RULES WITH JOKERS

Just matching the tiles is not enough; you must empower them.

Turn the rules of the game in your favor with special "Joker Cards" you will collect throughout your adventure.

• Scorers: Multiply your score with cards like "Only Red tiles give 2x points" or "Gain extra points if you use even numbers."

• Game Makers: Gain the right to hold more tiles in your hand or unlock more options in the market.

..

                                

🧪 DRİNKS: FRIENDS FOR TOUGH DAYS

Are things not going well?

Are you left with useless tiles in your hand?

Change your fate by using the single-use Drinks in your inventory.

                  

🛠️ CREATE YOUR OWN LUCK

You don't have to rely on chance. With deckbuilding mechanics, manipulate your deck:

- Keep getting bad tiles? Permanently remove them from your deck.

- Start each run with uniquely themed decks featuring different rule sets, bringing fresh strategies to every game.   

                                

👹 CHALLENGE THE BOSSES

The "Boss" levels waiting for you at the end of each section don't just demand high scores; they restrict you.

• "Curse of Odds": Odd-numbered tiles are worth 0 points.

• "Pattern Breaker": The same set cannot be repeated in each hand.

..

        

💰 RISK OR SECURITY?

Should you spend your earned gold immediately to power up, or save it to generate interest income? Managing your economy is just as crucial as managing your tiles. A rich strategy or a full wallet? The choice is yours.   

In Rummy Odyssey, luck is only the beginning victory depends on your strategy.

store_data.about_the_game:
Party Pong is a 2-4 player online multiplayer beer pong party game with a action card twist. Sink clutch shots, draw ridiculous cards, and turn every round into a full-blown chaotic experience. Whether you’re sweating for the win or shooting for fun, one thing’s guaranteed someone’s getting cooked.

CLASSIC BEER PONG WITH A TWIST

Line up your shots and turn into a pong legend... Every made cup can swing momentum with buffs, curses, distractions, and absolute nonsense. It’s beer pong… but strategy and chaos are always one card away.

ACTION CARDS

Use a growing arsenal of cards to boost your shots, sabotage your opponents, bend the rules, and create highlight-reel moments.
From clean power-ups to “who approved this?” curse cards, every match turns into a new story. 

   

ONLINE CO-OP

Play your way. Party Pong supports 2 to 4 players, Start a match with friends or hop into a quick match either way it’s loud, competitive, friendship threatening energy.

DISRUPT, DISTRACT, DOMINATE

Talk your trash and back it up. Trigger distractions, mess with your opponent’s focus, and create the kind of moments that will make your whole party scream. Winning is great… but winning while being toxic is better.

BEER PONG FEATURES

Redemption

Redemption gives you one last chance to clutch up and fight your way back into the game. If your team is down to the final cup and your opponent sinks it, you have the opportunity to hit a shot of your own to stay in the game.

Bouncing

A single bounce can instantly change the game. Bouncing rewards players with 2 cups!! 

Heating Up / On Fire

Heating Up and On Fire turns streaks. Hitting consecutive shots makes your team enter a powered-up state where you shoot until you miss.

Death Cup

store_data.about_the_game:
Manage your factory, watch numbers grow, and improve it endlessly.

Dumbers is an automation game where you extract numbers, process them with math operations, and deliver to the Hub to progress through infinite levels. Focus on building and refining your factory step by step.

KEY FEATURES

15 UNIQUE BUILDINGS

• 5 Extractor Tiers (T1 to elite T5)

• Mathematical processors that add and multiply the collected items (Adders, Incrementers, Doublers, Triplers, Quadruplers)

• Transport & Logistics (Belts, Express Belts, Mergers, Splitters)

No complex math needed: relax as numbers multiply and flow through your factory.

SYNERGY & STRATEGY SYSTEM

Smart design beats brute force. Processor placement matters:

• Synergy Bonuses: Chain processors strategically for up to +30% bonuses (ADDER → MULTIPLIER, INCREMENTER → ADDER, ADDER CHAINS, MIXED combinations)

• Diminishing Returns: The more processors a resource passes through, the smaller the gain from each one — and longer chains also become slower. Optimize your production lines wisely!

• Dynamic Penalties: Excessive splitters, mergers, and logistics abuse reduce final output at the Hub

• Real-time Feedback: Visual indicators show efficiency and penalties as numbers flow through your factory

Build diverse, efficient layouts instead of spamming the same buildings.

STRATEGIC CHOICES

Resources have dual use: level up to unlock new buildings, or invest in permanent upgrades for production boosts. Every choice enhances your factory's efficiency.

11 UPGRADE PATHS

Boost extraction speed, cut processing time, speed up belts, and more. Unlock bonuses like Lucky Extractor (2x random values) and Processor Efficiency (extra outputs). Each path has 5 progressive levels.

RELAXED GAMEPLAY

• Pause anytime for planning

• Color-coded buildings with efficiency indicators

• Satisfying particle effects and animations

• Idle progression—factory runs while away

• Multiple save slots and auto-save

• Are you tired of placing buildings, or have you reached high levels and the resources you obtain no longer matter? Press Z and admire Zen Mode as you travel through numbers!

INFINITE PROGRESSION

15+ levels with growing targets. Beyond level 15, challenges scale infinitely.

Design efficient layouts. Discover optimal synergy combinations. Master the balance between diversity and optimization in your factory.

You take on the role of Brice, a corrupt police officer with his own questionable methods, trying to get into the narcotics division. His path forward is controlled by another corrupt figure the person responsible for recruiting new narcotics officers whose demands push Brice even deeper into the dirt.

On a random, ordinary workday, Brice wakes up and starts cleaning his apartment after a fight with his girlfriend the night before. He then heads to the station and clocks in. During his routine patrol, he encounters both minor and serious crimes, using his badge in ways that blur the line between law and self interest. The last dispatch call is the most serious one yet.

store_data.about_the_game:
The Apartment is a first-person psychological horror
where a familiar space begins to live by someone else’s rules.

You wake up in your apartment. At first glance, everything looks the same: the same rooms, the same objects, the same silence. But only at first glance. A strange feeling won’t leave you, as if something has changed.

Suddenly, the silence is shattered by a deafening siren. The countdown has already begun. But what will happen when the time runs out?

In the bedroom, the computer is on. On the screen a code input window.

And then you hear a voice: It demands that you enter the code.

The siren keeps drilling into your ears, making it impossible to concentrate. You don’t understand what is happening or why it’s happening to you.

When the timer reaches zero, the air begins to change. It becomes heavier, denser, and somewhere beyond the walls you hear a quiet, almost imperceptible hiss.

It’s gas.

It slowly fills the apartment.

The apartment is full of details that once seemed insignificant. Hidden compartments, notes, cryptic codes, forgotten objects… All of them are pieces of a puzzle whose meaning you have yet to understand.

Old VHS cameras are watching your every step.

Returning to familiar rooms and discovering new fragments, you begin to see the bigger picture. The apartment holds the answers — but it won’t give them up easily.

Uncover what happened.

And find a way out before it’s too late.

By any means necessary.

Inspired by classic psychological horror and the aesthetics of analog horror and VHS.

DIVE INTO THE CO-OP MAYHEM

Why ruin someone's vacation alone when you can do it with friends? Grab your squad and split the duties: one person scans, one barks orders, and everyone else tries not to lose their minds.

DIG THROUGH WEIRD STUFF

Treat every suitcase like a loot box from a fever dream. You’ll find definitely-not-illegal things hidden in most unexpected places. It’s messy, it’s nosy, and it’s definetely glorious.

FLEX YOUR AIRPORT AUTHORITY

You’re the king of the metal detector, so start acting like it! Feel like confiscating a cactus? Do it. Want to deport a guy just because his passport photo is too smug? No problem. Your scanner, your rules.

FOLLOW INSTRUCTIONS

Don’t overthink it. There is no need to make everything exceptional. Just follow simple instructions you’ve been given. Spot the banned stuff, stamp the papers, and keep the line moving.

FEATURES

  • An airport where you must ensure total security

  • Crowds of impatient passengers

  • Contraband in suitcases

  • A cute little dog

  • A stun gun

  • Name badges

  • The fate of vacations is in your hands

store_data.about_the_game:
Build, expand, and destroy. In this card strategy game, you're not just surviving — you're fighting a war. Collect poker combinations to develop the settlement, manage individual decks of Outposts to contain the threat, and use powerful artifacts. Your goal is to completely clear the map of monsters.

BUILD AN IMPREGNABLE FORTRESS

Forget about the boring shuffling of cards. Your settlement is a complex mechanism. To build a forge, a wall or a tower of magicians, you need to collect the perfect combination of cards in your hand. Plan your moves, discard the excess and look for synergies that will turn your village into an economic war machine.

MANAGE MULTI-DECKS

The main feature of the game is Outposts. These are not just buildings, but your strategic outposts on the edge of darkness.

Separate Decks: Each Outpost has its own mini-deck and mechanics.

Threat Deterrence: The more effective your outposts are, the lower the chance of a surprise monster attack on the capital.

Expansion: Competent management of several decks at the same time is the key to victory.

ADAPT OR DIE.

The world is cruel. You will face Disasters: droughts, epidemics and magical storms will test your defenses. But what doesn't kill you makes you stronger. Find and use Permanent Cards (Artifacts) — global bonuses that stay with you and change the rules of the game, allowing you to create unique builds for each party.

THE GOAL: TOTAL EXTERMINATION

In most games, you hide from monsters. Here you go for them. Your task is not to last N days, but to destroy the entire population of monsters.

store_data.detailed_description:
Build, expand, and destroy. In this card strategy game, you're not just surviving — you're fighting a war. Collect poker combinations to develop the settlement, manage individual decks of Outposts to contain the threat, and use powerful artifacts. Your goal is to completely clear the map of monsters.

BUILD AN IMPREGNABLE FORTRESS

Forget about the boring shuffling of cards. Your settlement is a complex mechanism. To build a forge, a wall or a tower of magicians, you need to collect the perfect combination of cards in your hand. Plan your moves, discard the excess and look for synergies that will turn your village into an economic war machine.

MANAGE MULTI-DECKS

The main feature of the game is Outposts. These are not just buildings, but your strategic outposts on the edge of darkness.

Separate Decks: Each Outpost has its own mini-deck and mechanics.

Threat Deterrence: The more effective your outposts are, the lower the chance of a surprise monster attack on the capital.

Expansion: Competent management of several decks at the same time is the key to victory.

ADAPT OR DIE.

The world is cruel. You will face Disasters: droughts, epidemics and magical storms will test your defenses. But what doesn't kill you makes you stronger. Find and use Permanent Cards (Artifacts) — global bonuses that stay with you and change the rules of the game, allowing you to create unique builds for each party.
